name: rate-limiting
description: Rate limit incoming requests by second, minute, hour, day, month, or year.

fields.name: minute
fields.label: Minute Limit
fields.description: The number of HTTP requests allowed per minute.

fields.name: hour
fields.label: Hour Limit
fields.description: The number of HTTP requests allowed per hour.

fields.name: policy
fields.label: Policy
fields.description: The rate-limiting strategy used to retrieve and increment counters.

fields.name: fault_tolerant
fields.label: Fault Tolerant
fields.description: A boolean value that determines if the request should be proxied even if Kong is unable to connect to Redis/Cluster.

fields.name: hide_client_headers
fields.label: Hide Client Headers
fields.description: Optionally hide rate limit headers from the client.
